content.rendered:
Per the directive from Oregon’s Governor, Kate Brown, all Oregon schools are closed for the remainder of the 2019-2020 school year. 

If you need assistance with registration information for your student for the fall of 2020, please leave a message at 503-825-5100 or email at slemmert@sherwood.k12.or.us.  A link to the Sherwood School District Enrollment page can be found HERE.
During these challenging times we hope that all of you are finding ways to remain healthy and stay connected to family and friends.
